messages:
nina: Heads up — Casey handed in resignation today. Last day is 2026-06-04. Need owners for access cutover, laptop return, and benefits/Cobra mail.

omar: I can take SSO and cloud credential revokes. Please list any org-admin roles and SSH keys Casey has.

leah: I'll take VPN, vault rotation, and service account key revocations. Note: we should preserve audit logs and update rotation notes.

nina: Draft plan (edit inline):
• create IT ticket and attach inventory (People Ops)
• schedule exit interview + final payroll check (People Ops)
• disable SSO on last working day, keep email accessible for 24h for payroll (Omar)
• revoke personal deploy keys and PATs; rotate CI tokens (Omar & Leah)
• rotate shared secrets and update vault policies (Leah)
• remove from on-call and alerting groups (Omar)
• confirm hardware serial and shipping label or drop-off (Nina)
• benefits end date, COBRA packet + opt-in instructions sent (People Ops)

casey: Laptop serial is SN-RW-2345. I have two personal keys (work@home, macbook-pro). Happy to coordinate handoff notes this week.

omar: I'll run a sweep for repo keys, org tokens, and cloud service account keys. Commands I'll use: 
```
# list user SSH keys (GitHub)
gh api /user/keys
# remove gcloud SA key
gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete KEY_ID --iam-account=sa@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
I'll attach findings to ticket.

leah: For vault/secret rotation: after keys revoked do 
```
vault kv delete secret/team/casey
vault rotate shared-api-key
```
If a team needs emergency access post-cutover, create a time-limited service account and document in ticket.

it-ops-bot: Created IT-5902 — "Access removal + laptop return for Casey (LD 2026-06-04)". Assigned to Omar. Initial ETA 1 business day. :white_check_mark:

nina: COBRA timeline: benefits active through 2026-06-30 (EOM). We'll send COBRA packet 2026-06-03 with vendor link and one-page instructions. Also confirm final PTO payout with payroll.

omar: Suggested staged schedule on last day: 
1) 09:00 disable SSO (preserve email 24h)
2) 10:00 revoke personal keys & tokens
3) 10:15 remove from on-call and notification groups
4) 11:00 rotate shared secrets and update docs

casey: I'll drop the laptop at reception on my last day. I'm open to a 30-min knowledge transfer after close if helpful.

leah: Reminder: check 3rd-party SaaS admin ownership (CI, analytics, monitoring). If Casey is sole admin anywhere, transfer before last day.

nina: Good point. Add findings to IT-5902. I'll send exit interview invite once ticket has full inventory and confirm shipping/drop-off logistics. :rocket:
